region.text: the 28 cells of the founding discs that fall in Lebanon, Syria and Sinai, outside the page's "today's Jordan, Israel and Palestinian territories"

events.note: Pairs with keyframe_overrides/0: the found event's discs reach Lebanon (15 cells), Syria (11) and Sinai (2); the page gives the range as "today's Jordan, Israel and Palestinian territories", so those cells never belonged to the culture and are dropped in the founding year.
